description: Forwards the events Reclaim sends to the org's pull listener to a local route, like `stripe listen --forward-to`. Call it when the app's callback route runs locally. It POSTs each envelope as JSON to `http://127.0.0.1:<port><path>` (loopback only; also tries `[::1]`) and acknowledges 2xx responses. Events of one session arrive in order. When the app rejects an event, including with a redirect, that session is held and retried with backoff (2 s up to 30 s) while other sessions keep flowing. Creates the listener on first use, so it is not read-only. One forwarder runs per org: call again to read status, or with another `port` or `path` to retarget. `stop: true` stops forwarding only. Forwarding lasts only while this MCP server runs; production needs `create_org_callback_subscription`. Returns `{ forwarding, target, listener, forwarded, failed, lastError?, recent, blocked }`. `listener.expiresAt` is the lease end, and `recent` lists the last events with `status` and `httpStatus`. `blocked` lists each held session as `{ sessionId, event, eventId, httpStatus?, attempts, lastError?, since }`, and is `[]` when none is held. When `blocked` is not empty, check the app's response and logs for that session. The app must return 2xx for a result that failed verification, and 5xx only for a temporary error. Fix the app, and the session resumes on the next retry.

orgToken.description: The organization API key (`rorg_…`). Defaults to the server's `RECLAIM_ORG_SECRET`, then the key saved by `issue_org_token`. Never echo it back to the user.

path.description: The callback route, starting with `/`. Defaults to `/`.

port.description: The local port the app listens on.

name: proxy_callback_events
